newsitem.title: USA: Market Facts sets 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Market Facts sets 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: Market Facts Corp said its board declared a two-for-one stock split in the form of a dividend on the common stock of the company.
Shareholders will receive one additional share of Market Facts stock for every one share held on the record date.
The split will be distributed on May 27 to shareholders of record at the close of business on May 12, the company said.

The company also announced that shareholders approved an increase in the number of authorized shares of common stock to 15 million shares, allowing the company to do the split and issue shares for future purposes.
Market Facts collects and sells market research.
